stable.notes: The consolidated release of everything since 0.5.139. The Session Pet's idle chrome is a ledger bar above the sprite: amber for sessions waiting on you always at the front, a breathing green for running work, gold for finished, with a counted caption. Hover cross-fades the bar into RUNNING, DONE, and WAITING pills in the same slot and unfolds the focused session's title card and actions; the pills pin the live and finished lists, WAITING jumps to the session that needs you, and nothing above the sprite ever changes size, so the character never moves. Finished sessions persist per session for four hours across relaunches, capped at eight, and clicking one opens it in Control. Clicking a Claude Code session running in a terminal raises iTerm2 or Terminal instead of Claude Desktop, keyed on the session's own recorded entrypoint. Miles Windu ships the approved V15.3 stories: 16, 17, and 13 frames for one, two, and three sessions, and the 25-frame four-plus swarm with the clockwise spin, reverse-grip strike, electrical breakup, and visible saber release, flip, and catch. Character speed is a saved 25% to 200% control; the stock idle renders at 3x. Stock packs upgrade by exact-byte match and custom artwork is never touched. macOS Reduced Motion drops every slide and the bar's breathing. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
